Pick a chassis

Three candidates, each built in Blender on the shared rig and shown at true scale beside a 1.8 m pilot and a four-storey block. Climb into the cockpit to see what you'd fight from. These are untextured design models (colours only); Material Maker textures come once a design is picked.

Orbit

Drag to orbit, scroll or pinch to zoom, right drag to pan. In the cockpit, drag to look around. Rig test drives the contract's bones (torso_twist, thigh, shin, hock) the way the engine will.

Grid: 4 m cells. The yellow rail is 12 m (survey M1). Sizes and triangle counts are measured off each glb by the generator, not typed.
